D.Va’s mech is nimble and powerful — its twin Ability Fusion Cannons blast away with autofire at short range, and she can use its Ability Boosters to barrel over enemies and obstacles, or absorb attacks with her projectile-destroying Ability Defense Matrix.

entries.name: Tokki, 토끼
entries.content: Tokki (토끼) is a Bipedal Meka piloted by Hana "D.va" Song. Tokki is powered by a miniaturized reactor, which can be overloaded to make the mech explode. Tokki takes Bipedal form and has high walk speed with increased close-quarters agility. The addition of boosters offer the ability to produce bursts of speed to close the distance between Tokki and a target, as well as retreat for repairs. Tokki carries lots of armour and is very survivable, although a significant weak spot is the armoured window for the pilot. A feature that mitigates this issue is an integrated Hard Light Active Protection System which can intercept most projectiles encountered on the battlefield. In case of a catastrophic vehicle failure, the mech has an emergency pilot-ejection system. Tokki's main armament is two short-range gatling-style fusion cannons that are powered by the onboard reactor. Because of their power source, the cannons don't need to reload and thus are capable of sustained, suppressive fire. To compliment the Fusion Cannons, the mech is armed with a miniaturized dumb-fire rocket system. The Fusion Cannons can also be used to punch.

entries.name: Hard-Light, Hard Light
entries.content: Hard-Light is a type of technology considered to be a "radical" technology. It is the process of creating physical objects from a light source. Hard-light uses projectors, which increases the interactivity of photons and binds them together. Carbon molecules are drawn in, which collide with the photonic structures. The carbon bonds together, creating real, lasting, physical objects made from carbon fiber.

entries.name: Doomfist, Akande Ogundimu, Akande
entries.content:
A highly trained fighter and born leader, Doomfist (47 years old) is determined to plunge the world into a new conflict that he believes will make humanity stronger. He says the global order is unjust, created "to protect criminals from the division they create." In his mind, the solution is to tear it down. He is aware that his actions have cost countless lives, but by his calculus, he has saved many more. Doomfist possesses great strength and agility, even without his Gauntlet weapon, in part due to his cybernetic implants. He is an excellent martial artist, has superhuman levels of concentration, and is a master strategist.
Doomfist’s cybernetics make him a highly-mobile, powerful frontline fighter. In addition to dealing ranged damage with his Hand Cannon, Doomfist can slam the ground, knock enemies into the air and off balance, or charge into the fray with his Rocket Punch. When facing a tightly packed group, Doomfist leaps out of view, then crashes down to earth with a spectacular Meteor Strike.

entries.name: Hazard, Findlay Docherty, Findlay
entries.content:
Hazard (24 years old) is a charismatic and contrarian punk rocker. His story is one of resilience and survival. The Phreaks are Hazard's "found family," and his loyalty to them and their anti-establishment ideals are core to who he is. A radical disruptor and an unstoppable weapon, Hazard has rocketed to fame in the criminal underworld as he fights to tear the system down. To the oppressed and downtrodden, Hazard is a hero; to the rich and powerful, he is a terrifying menace... and that’s just the way he likes it.
Hazard's cybernetics allow him to be a highly mobile. His cybernetics have a shotgun inbuilt into them, also powering his jum. The Vanadium injection grants him the ability of a shield with being able to fire homing spikes onto nearby attackers. He can build Vanadium crystalline walls that also knock back and deal damage.

entries.name: Junker Queen, Odessa "Dez" Stone, Odessa Stone, Dez
entries.content:
The Junker Queen (also known as "the Queen of Junkertown" or simply "the Queen") (31 years old) is the cutthroat leader of the Junkers. The Queen is fierce, resourceful, and no stranger to survival, happy to run headfirst into battle. Possessing a magnetic gauntlet, the Queen often wields an axe and blade in conjunction, able to call them back using said gauntlet, in order to achieve her brutal ends. She is also proficient in the electric guitar.
For the Queen, every city is her battlefield, every seat is her throne, and everyone on the planet is her subject—whether they know it or not. All the Junkers have to be careful from getting on her bad side. She has a group of enforcers that she sends to the people of Junkertown when they don't pay their taxes, among other tasks. She is prejudiced against omnics, and has banned them from entering Junkertown.
Many of her abilities apply wounds that cause enemies to slowly lose health. She also has a life-steal passive that adds to her survivability and aggression. Pushing the boundaries of brawling, Junker Queen can be considered a "berserker tank," whose survivability is directly connected to how many enemies she's wounding.
entries.comment: Junker Queen, Odessa "Dez" Stone, Odessa Stone, Dez

entries.name: Junkertown
entries.content: Junkertown is a dirty, dangerous, harsh, chaotic, grungy settlement located in the Australian Outback, constructed from the ruins of the Australian omnium. It is the home of the Junkers. The entrance to the town is a fortified gate with a guard tower. The denizens of the town are taxed, and if they don't pay up, Queen Odessa Stone sends her henchmen around to collect what's due. Junkertown does have some amenities that one would expect from a proper town—repair shops, bars, tattoo shops, etc. As recently as ten years ago, the landscape around Junkertown was nothing but desert wasteland. In the present day, the landscape has recovered to an extent.

entries.name: Junker, Junkers
entries.content:
The origins of the Junkers lie with the destruction of the country's omnium, which turned the Outback into an irradiated wasteland that was uninhabitable to most humans. Those who survived formed the Junkers, who scavenged the husk of the omnium and formed a lawless, cutthroat society in its shadow. The Junkers are divided into squabbling factions that are kept in line by their queen. Examples include the Tinkers and the Wreckers.
The Junkers continue to pilfer the omnium. When they aren't doing that, the Junkers blow off steam in the Scrapyard—a massive gladiatorial arena whose combatants fight for glory, riches...and to survive.
The Junkers are ruled by a monarch which is chosen through the Reckoning, a combat event held in the Scrapyard. Their ruler has the authority to banish Junkers into the surrounding Wasteland. At least prior to the rule of Odessa Stone, the Junkers were generally prejudiced against Wastelanders. Under Stone's rule, the Junkers' anti-omnic stance was solidified/established.

entries.name: Mauga, Maugaloa Malosi, Maugaloa
entries.content:
A charismatic and cunning Samoan warrior, Mauga (37 years old) thrives in the chaos of the battlefield and lives every day like it's his last. Wherever Mauga goes, he knows how to have a good time, and experience has taught him to treat every day like it's his last.
Tall and muscular, Mauga's size and strength have been augmented. This includes a second cybernetic heart, and a subsequent upgrade to his organic heart.
He says was more serious prior to said augmentations, before gaining a "new outlook on life." In his current persona, Mauga often portrays himself as being a "big dumb brute." However, this is a facade, as he possesses cunning attributes. He talks fast and loose, and has a tendency to treat strangers as if they are friends. He is proficient in close combat; Baptiste regarded him as being "like a demon"; a sociopath and sadist, Mauga flips between his lighter and darker sides quickly, though can lose himself in the latter. Only Baptiste has ever been able to talk him down from this state in the field. Baptiste himself serves as a blindspot for Mauga, who's shown him mercy where he might otherwise not do so.
Mauga features a kit that is designed to bash through the front lines and brawl his opponents in close-quarter combat, by wielding two powerful chainguns that can either be fired individually or in unison. Ignite enemies with his incendiary chaingun “Gunny” to burn them when they take enough damage, then finish them with a critical hit from his volatile chaingun “Cha-Cha.” Paired with his Berserker passive, which grants Mauga temporary health whenever he deals critical damage, he’s a mountain on the battlefield.

entries.name: Cybernetics, Cybernetic, Cyborg, Cyborgs
entries.content:
Cybernetics is the interdisciplinary study of the structure of regulatory systems. The field involves the replacement and/or improvement of an organism's organic components with robotic ones.  Sand and salt water don't agree with cybernetics.
Cyborgs are organisms with cybernetics in them.

entries.name: Orisa
entries.content:
Orisa is a newly-created (1 year old) omnic with both a heart and personality. Urged to become a hero by her creator, Efi Oladele, Orisa strives to right wrongs and act as the hero the world needs. While her relative inexperience can make her an occasional liability, Efi's optimism and willingness to make modifications to Orisa's adaptive artificial intelligence have always been able to set things right. While Orisa has much to learn about the world and its functionality, Orisa stands ready to protect both Efi and Numbani with her growing sense of honor and duty.
She is a fan of Lúcio's music. She is named after the orisha; spirits reflecting one of the manifestations of the Supreme Divinity in Yoruba religion.
Orisa defends her teammates from the frontline with a protective barrier. She can attack from long range, fortify her own defenses, launch graviton charges to slow and move enemies, and deploy a Supercharger to boost the damage output of multiple allies at once. She can also carry out biometric scans, and is equipped with a transponder that Efi can use to track her.

entries.name: Efi Oladele, Efi
entries.content: Efi Oladele is an 11 year old inventor from Numbani with notable achievements in robotics and artificial intelligence, including the creation of Orisa.

entries.name: Numbani
entries.content: Known as the City of Harmony, Numbani is one of the few places where omnics and humans live as equals. This collaboration has led to the creation of one of the world's greatest and most technologically advanced cities in the short time since its establishment after the end of the Omnic Crisis.

entries.name: Ramattra
entries.content:
Ramattra's (28 years old) story is one of hardships, trauma, and a magnified view of humanity’s harsh realities. While created as a war machine, Ramattra has only ever wanted to create a better future for omnics. As the leader of Null Sector, Ramattra enjoys incredible support from his people, and is primed to impose his philosophies on the world. What his goals might cost, however, remains to be seen.
Because of their precarious situation, Ramattra believes that omnics should only care about their own kind, and never consider humanity in their struggle for survival. He is not above working with humans however. Despite their divergent paths, he remains fond of Zenyatta, and believes there is no omnic in the world who understands him better (though Nameless is a close second). Despite being his creator, Ramattra despises Anubis.
Ramattra is mostly emotionally reserved, but his anger can boil over while in battle. His Nemesis form is a product of his own design; a product of his genius mind, and the manifestation of his rage. He uses it sparingly however, as he prefers tactical precision to brute force.
Ramattra is a dual-form hero. His omnic form lets him protect his teammates using a staff as his weapon, while his Nemesis form transforms him into a larger and more menacing threat, where he marches down on the enemy team.

entries.name: Null Sector
entries.content: Null Sector is a militant omnic liberation group that utilizes violent methods to achieve omnic rights. Its forces are almost entirely comprised of robotic drones manufactured in an omnium under the direction of Ramattra, one of its original founders and currently its sole leader. They were decried as terrorists by the Shambali Order following the King's Row Uprising, going underground until their re-emergence. Now, Null Sector is regarded as one of the world's most notorious terrorist organizations. Their implied goal is to create an omnic nation.

entries.name: Null Sector
entries.content:
Nameless is an omnic, and former member of Null Sector. Nameless doesn't have a name, nor do they desire one. "Nameless" is its name only in the sense of giving other individuals something to call it. Their model was made as a companion for children, with a built-in battery for charging devices and taking pictures. Nameless is highly customized and short, with blue eyes and rabbit-like ears. Their model designation has been scratched out, apparently by Nameless themselves.
Of all the members of Null Sector, Nameless perhaps knew Ramattra best. In Ramattra's words, Nameless was "the omnic who knew me better than anyone, save for my brother."

entries.name: Reinhardt, Reinhardt Wilhelm
entries.content:
A highly decorated soldier with a strong moral compass, Reinhardt Wilhelm (63 years old) styles himself as a champion of a bygone age, who lives by the knightly codes of valor, justice, and courage. Possessing an "active imagination," he enjoys eating currywurst, is talkative, and is a fan of David Hasselhoff's music, along with Krankenwagen Grün. He spars with Brigitte every day, after which they go to a pub or tavern to relax. He is not good with computers.
Clad in powered armor and swinging his hammer, Reinhardt leads a rocket-propelled charge across the battleground and defends his squadmates with a massive energy barrier.

entries.name: Roadhog, Mako Rutledge, Mako
entries.content:
50 years old, 7'3" (221 cm) tall, and 550 lbs (250 kg), Roadhog is a ruthless killer with a well-earned reputation for cruelty and wanton destruction. He remains silent most of the time. He wears a mask with "hogdrogen" inhalers, which contain a pressurized chemical mixture that helps counteract the effects of radiation exposure. Despite his outwardly brutal appearance, Roadhog is a sound tactician.
Mako watched as his home became an apocalyptic wasteland after getting taken over by omnics, and he was forever changed. Adapting to his environment, he donned a mask and took to the broken highways. Little by little, his humanity was forgotten. The last vestiges of Mako faded away and the ruthless killer Roadhog was born. He continued to dwell in his farm, which was located on the outskirts of Junkertown.
Roadhog uses his signature Chain Hook to pull his enemies close before shredding them with blasts from his Scrap Gun. He’s hardy enough to withstand tremendous damage, and can recover his health with a short breather of Hogdrogen.

entries.name: Hogdrogen
entries.content: Hogdrogen is a yellow pressurized chemical mixture that counteracts the effects of radiation exposure on those who inhale it. It is usually seen contained in stout yellow inhaler cans that are compatible with some gas mask filters. In Junkertown, empty cans can be found for sale at Bruce's Wreckyard. A specialized machine can be used to refill hogdrogen cans.

entries.name: Sigma, Siebren de Kuiper, Siebren
entries.content:
Sigma (64 years old) is an eccentric and volatile astrophysicist who gained the power to control gravity in an orbital experiment gone wrong where he was exposed to a black hole. Manipulated by Talon and deployed as a living weapon, Sigma's presence on the battlefield cannot be ignored.
De Kuiper is mentally damaged. He thinks about the universe, gravity, and physics all through the same 'prism', seeing them as being akin to music. He has high regard for the work of Mei-Ling Zhou, finding it "brilliant."

entries.name: Talon
entries.content:
Talon is a terrorist organization and one of the main antagonistic factions to Overwatch's narrative.
Talon is comprised of a variety of individuals, each with their own goals and ideas. Through its leader Doomfist, its current manifesto is that humanity is made stronger through conflict. Consequently, Talon seeks to sow turmoil across the globe to strengthen the human race. Repeatedly, Talon has demonstrated disregard for the standard rules of engagement, attacking both military and civilian targets with impunity. It has orbital surveillance capabilities.
Its members lacked the camaraderie seen in Overwatch. In Talon, there is no pretense of harmony among its members. Ultimately, the group is a means to an end for its members, who pursue their own agendas.
Talon operatives have a high rate of injury in the field.

entries.name: Wrecking Ball, Hammond
entries.content:
(16 years old)
Witty and conniving, Hammond is a genetically modified hamster capable of speech, just not in any human language. His mech (named "Wrecking Ball") translates his comments into English via a soundboard. The mech itself is equipped with a minor AI.
Per his nature as a hamster, Hammond has an instinctual fear of foxes. A perfectionist, Hammond is highly intelligent, and there is little he cannot fix or build.
Wrecking Ball rolls across the battlefield, using his arsenal of weapons and his  mech’s powerful wrecking ball-shaped body to crush his enemies.

entries.name: Artificial Intelligence, AI
entries.content:
Artificial intelligence is, broadly speaking, the intelligence of machines or software, as opposed to the intelligence of humans or animals. Artificial intelligence is limited by processing power and available resources.
Prior to the Omnic Crisis, humanity had developed AI that was on par with human intellect itself. Small, less complex AIs orchestrated traffic flows, ensured food stores were stocked, and managed public works. As AI continued to proliferate, the specter of unemployment loomed in the sectors it affected. By the period just before the Omnic Crisis, the majority of the world's engineering firms had pivoted to rely on AI.

entries.name: Zarya, Sasha, Aleksandra Zaryanova, Александра Зарянова, Aleksandra, Александра
entries.content:
Aleksandra Zaryanova (30 years old) is one of the world's strongest women, a celebrated athlete who sacrificed personal glory to protect her family, friends, and country in a time of war. As a soldier in the Russian Defense Forces, she is proud to use her strength to protect the ones she loves.
Zarya has good tactical instincts. She is distrustful of omnics, even those who seek co-existence with humanity. However, after her experiences with Lynx Seventeen, her views softened, distinguishing between the Siberian omnics attacking her homeland, and the rest of omnic-kind in general. Similarly, Zarya initially disdained Overwatch, at least in part due to the rivalry between Overwatch and the RDF, but she softened her stance after joining the organization.
She enjoys eating cabbage pierogis.
Zarya is an invaluable asset on the front lines of any battle, deploying powerful personal barriers that convert incoming damage into energy for her massive Particle Cannon, unleashes a beam of destructive energy.
entries.comment: Zarya, Sasha, Aleksandra Zaryanova, Александра Зарянова, Aleksandra, Александра

entries.name: Lynx Seventeen, Lynx
entries.content:
Lynx has a dry wit. They regard being a hacker as part of their identity. They see humans and omnics as being similar, as both being programmed both figuratively and literally. Their muzzle-shaped mouth and antennae give them some resemblance to the large wild cats with which share their name. The three diodes in the center of their forehead allow them to interface remotely with computer systems. Lynx is gender neutral and prefers others to refer to them as "they" and "them."
Lynx was contacted by Katya Volskaya to aid her agent Zarya in her search for the hacker known as Sombra. Their meeting in Numbani began on a wrong foot, given Zarya's dislike of omnics.

entries.name: Katya Volskaya
entries.content: Katya Volskaya is the CEO of Volskaya Industries. She holds great political and social influence within Russia, and is regarded as a hero by the Russian people. Katya oversaw Volskaya Industries as part of Russia's war with the reactivated Siberian omnium.

entries.name: Volskaya Industries
entries.content:
Volskaya Industries is a Russian company involved in Svyatogor production, and is Russia's premier anti-omnic security force.
Russia was one of the countries hit hardest by the Omnic Crisis, but during the rebuilding process, it rode the wave of the mechanized labor industry's revitalization and entered a period of rapid growth. However, after recent attacks from the long-dormant Siberian omnium, Russia has returned to war footing, guarding its sparkling cities with the massive, human-piloted Svyatogor mechs.

entries.name: Svyatogor, Святогoр, Volskaya Mech, Volskaya Mechs
entries.content: The Svyatogor is a type of human-piloted mechanized walker produced by Volskaya Industries. They successfully defended Russia during the Omnic Crisis. These mechs continue to be used in the defense of Russia against omnic forces in Siberia, assigned to guard Russia's cities.
entries.comment: Svyatogor, Святогoр, Volskaya Mech, Volskaya Mechs

entries.name: Russian Defense Forces, RDF
entries.content: The RDF are the armed forces of Russia. The RDF has access to tanks, helicopters, transport vehicles, and fighter jets, along with standard infantry. The RDF fought against the omnics during the Omnic Crisis. In an exception to the rest of the world, the RDF was able to defeat the omnics without the aid of Overwatch, as they fought their way through the omnic forces in Siberia and shut down the region's omnium.

entries.name: Ashe, Elizabeth Caledonia "Calamity" Ashe, Elizabeth, Elizabeth Ashe
entries.content:
Ashe (41 years old) is the ambitious and calculating leader of the Deadlock Gang and a respected figure in the criminal underworld.
A tough talker, Ashe has an organized mindset. This affects her ideas of how her organization should be run, to how relationships should work. Her relationship with Cole Cassidy is "way more complicated" than a simple label, though could be described as a "love-hate" type of relationship. Despite her callous exterior, Ashe has demonstrated concern for innocents caught up in Null Sector's war, and sympathy for omnics in general (B.O.B. especially).
As the daughter of socialites, Ashe feels just as comfortable at charity balls as she does on a motorcycle. She is a good shot with a rifle, believing that accuracy is key, and that all one should need is a single shot.
She blasts enemies by throwing dynamite, and her coach gun packs enough punch to put some distance between her and her foes, or gain some air to leap to hard to reach places or for an aerial shot. And Ashe is not alone, as she can call on her omnic ally B.O.B. to join the fray when the need arises.
entries.comment: Ashe, Elizabeth Caledonia "Calamity" Ashe, Elizabeth, Elizabeth Ashe

entries.name: Deadlock, Deadlock Rebels, Deadlock Gang
entries.content: A notorious crime group that operates big heists in the American southwest.

entries.name: B.O.B.
entries.content:
B.O.B. is Elizabeth Ashe's loyal, lifelong omnic butler and bodyguard. Kind-hearted and unable to speak. He communicates through body language such as blinks and hand gestures.
B.O.B. served as the butler of Elizabeth Ashe's family. Her parents paid little attention to her, and care of their daughter was mostly relegated to B.O.B. Thus, B.O.B. was there when Ashe's parents weren't. He was present when she partook in target shooting on the family estate. Throughout her youth, Ashe spent a lot of time talking to B.O.B., even though he couldn't talk back.

entries.name: Bastion
entries.content:
Once a frontline robot combatant in the devastating Omnic Crisis, Bastion (32 years old) has all but lost its combat programming and now explores its surroundings, fascinated by the world and its inhabitants.
Though his new nature is gentle, its core combat programming takes over when the unit senses danger, utilizing its entire arsenal to eliminate anything it perceives as a threat. This has led to instances of conflict with the few humans it has encountered, and it tries to avoid populated areas in favor of the wild, uncharted regions of the world. Bastion is fascinated by nature, but wary of a fearful humanity. Ganymede, a yellow bird, is his companion.
Can transform between Assault, Recon and devastating Artillery configurations.

entries.name: Cassidy, McCree, Cole Cassidy, Jesse McCree, Jesse
entries.content:
Armed with his Peacekeeper, the outlaw Cole Cassidy (39 years old) doles out justice on his own terms. At times, he has missed his old farm boy life. He enjoys liquor with "bite" to it, along with cookies. He refuses to eat pork.
Cassidy is an ace shot, and is known for staying cool under fire, and his charm, and adaptability. He prefers revolvers to rifles. While the latter may have improved accuracy, he prefers revolvers for their rate of fire, and one's ability to shoot from the hip. He prefers "traditional armaments" rather than more advanced weaponry, though has never used a bow. By his own admission, Cassidy is not a soldier, and has little enthusiasm for traditional military hierarchies/modes of operation. Cassidy knows how to play poker.
Cassidy takes out targets with deadeye precision and dives out of danger with eagle-like speed.
entries.comment: Cassidy, McCree, Cole Cassidy, Jesse McCree, Jesse

entries.name: Peacekeeper
entries.content: The Peacekeeper is the revolver used by Cole Cassidy. It was built by a legendary gunsmith, and fires custom high-caliber ammunition with technological enhancements.

entries.name: Echo
entries.content:
Echo (14 years old) is an evolutionary robot programmed with a rapidly adapting artificial intelligence, versatile enough to fill multiple battlefield combat roles, able to reconfigure herself on the fly (quite literally) to adapt to new situations, anything from medical support to construction. As she is exposed to new people, new ideas, and new situations without her creator to guide her, no one knows how she might evolve in the future.
Much of Echo's personality is based on Doctor Mina Liao, her creator. As she continues to adapt, free from the confines of a lab, those around her will decide whether Echo will remain an echo of her creator, or become her own person.

entries.name: Mina Liao
entries.content: Dr. Mina Liao (deceased) was the creator of Echo and one of the six founding members of Overwatch. Introverted, and seldom spoke publically. She held belief in the potential artificial life and its power to transform the lives of humanity for the better.

entries.name: Genji, Genji Shimada, 島田 源氏, 源氏
entries.content:
The cyborg Genji Shimada (37 years old) has made peace with the augmented body he once rejected, and in doing so, he has discovered a higher humanity. While wary of his past, he has acknowledged, and made peace with it. He (almost) always wears a mask, as, in his words, "I do not want people to fear me...or pity me."
Genji's sword is a katana named Ryū ichimonji (竜一文字); he maintains it personally and has never allowed anyone else to examine or repair it. It is paired with a traditional wakizashi sheathed horizontally on his lower back. He is proficient in Meikyo Shisui, Kenjutsu, Shurikenjutsu, Omnitsujutsu, and Intonjutsu.
Flings precise and deadly Shuriken at his targets, and uses his wakizashi to deflect projectiles or delivers a Swift Strike with his technologically-advanced "dragonblade" that cuts down enemies.
entries.comment: Genji, Genji Shimada, 島田 源氏, 源氏

entries.name: Hanzo, Hanzo Shimada, 島田 半蔵 , 半蔵
entries.content:
Mastering his skills as a bowman and an assassin, Hanzo Shimada (40 years old) strives to prove himself as a warrior without peer. He has a cynical view on the nature of the world, and believes that compassion has no place in battle.
In addition to his skills with the bow named Storm Bow (嵐ノ弓, Arashi no Yumi), Hanzo is likewise skilled with the sword, but has sworn off using such a weapon. He considers crossbows to be "toys for children," and refuses to use firearms, as "they make killing too simple." He carves wooden charms as a hobby, and dislikes cities, preferring quieter areas such as Kanezaka. He similarly avoids people in general.
Hanzo's versatile arrows can reveal his enemies or rapid fire to strike multiple targets. He can scale walls to fire his bow from on high, or summon a titanic spirit dragon.
entries.comment: Hanzo, Hanzo Shimada, 島田 半蔵 , 半蔵

entries.name: Kanezaka
entries.content:
Located in Japan, Kanezaka is a quiet area that straddles tradition and modernity. Weathered wooden buildings and a Shinto shrine guarded by solemn stone foxes border the bustle of a high-rise cityscape that trickles into the town proper. Much of its economy is kept afloat by tourism—people will come in by train, partake in the town's good and services, and then leave come nightfall. It regularly celebrates the End of Summer Festival and the Fox Festival. Kanezaka is located on the banks of a river, within range of a port.
One can cuddle up at the Cat Café, check out Mochi’s Pottery Workshop, drop by Tora no Sumika (the local bar), or simply stroll down the streets and enjoy the ambience.

entries.name: Junkrat, Jamison Fawkes, Jamison
entries.content:
Junkrat (27 years old) is an explosives-obsessed freak who lives to cause chaos and destruction. He is on a number of most-wanted lists. He has a low opinion of omnics and those who believe they can be trusted. He likewise has a low opinion of "suits" (corporate businesspersons), and Wastelanders, at least prior to the coronation of Odessa Stone.
Junkrat's hair carries a burning smell with it. He lost his right leg to an accident with a home-made explosive. Has a metallic peg leg. He dislikes shrimp.
Junkrat's area-denying armaments include a Frag Launcher that lobs bouncing grenades, Concussion Mines that send enemies flying, and Steel Traps that stop foes dead in their tracks.

entries.name: Mei, Mei-Ling Zhou, 周美灵, 美灵
entries.content:
Cheerful, creative, and optimistic, even in the face of overwhelming odds, Dr. Mei-Ling Zhou (33 years old) is a world-renowned climatologist who has taken the fight to preserve the environment into her own hands. She specializes in the study of abnormal climate phenomena and their effects on different ecosystems around the world. She strongly believes in preserving the world for future generations, and is determined to fight for a better future. While originally just a scientist, Winston's recall order has inspired her to heroism. Fan of Lúcio's music.
Mei’s weather-altering devices slow opponents and protect locations. Her Endothermic Blaster unleashes damaging icicles and frost streams, and she can Cryo-Freeze herself to guard against counterattacks, or obstruct movements with an Ice Wall.
entries.comment: Mei, Mei-Ling Zhou, 周美灵, 美灵

entries.name: Pharah, Fareeha Amari, Fareeha, فريحة عماري, فريحة
entries.content:
With a strong sense of justice, Pharah's (34 years old) commitment to duty runs in her blood. She comes from a long line of highly decorated soldiers and burns with the desire to serve with honor, and is dedicated to serving others. She is lesbian.
A serious but altruistic individual, she seeks to make the world a better place, and bring order out of chaos. She has a strong sense of self-identity, and her whole life, has known who she is as a person. She loves the feeling of entering the unknown, and has an udjat tatoo on her right eye, bearing the Eye of Horus. Every action she undertakes comes from "a deep place" within her spirit. Fareeha has a mixed relationship with her mother Ana, and while her relationship with her father was initially complicated as well, it is currently more familial. Pharah has strong instincts, honed by her training. She enjoys listening to Classic Rock, and is not a Boston Bruins fan.
Soars through the air in her combat armor and is armed with a launcher that lays down high-explosive rockets.
entries.comment: Pharah, Fareeha Amari, Fareeha, فريحة عماري, فريحة

entries.name: Reaper, Gabriel Reyes, Gabriel, Reyes
entries.content:
Thanks to his military training, Reaper (60 years old) has a 'sixth sense' for danger. Due to experiments carried out by Dr. Moira O'Deorain, Reaper's cells simultaneously decay and regenerate at a hyper-accelerated rate. The process has been described as "molecular cleansing," where he is "wiped away piece by piece." One moment he may appear as flesh and blood, the next, as a cloud of black smoke—disjointed, but still in control of his molecules. Even after the complete destruction of his body, he has been observed as being a "black mist," and is then able to regain physical form at a later point. He has described living in the condition as a form of "constant agony," though it is only through O'Deorain's experiments that he is able to stay alive. Because of these same treatments, Reaper finds it difficult to control his anger. He is sadistic but intelligent, with a keen sense of observation, and has talent in information-gathering. He prefers to operate behind the scenes.
Reaper dual-wields Hellfire shotguns, and is equipped with a specialized Reaper Mask. While the latter has its practical uses, Reaper also keeps it on to hide is disfigured face, and to not be recognized by his former family.
His past self was Gabriel Reyes. He had a sense of honor that his later persona came to consider antiquated. As Reaper, Reyes believes in a "code of violence," which is, in his view, the only code the world respects. To this end, he is willing to work with Talon, believing in Doomfist's vision for a new world order.
Hellfire Shotguns, the ghostly ability to become intangible, and the power to step between shadows make Reaper one of the deadliest beings on Earth.

entries.name: Hellfire Shotgun, Hellfire Shotguns
entries.content:
A pair of Hellfire shotguns are dual wielded by Gabriel Reyes.
There is evidence that the shotgun rounds have been laced with a biological agent—when Jack Morrison was shot, the flesh around the wounds turned necrotic rather than healing as rapidly as they usually would, leading him and Ana Amari to speculate about the rounds' possible properties. Similar effects were observed on a scientist shot by Reyes.

entries.name: Reaper Mask
entries.content:
The Reaper mask is the mask worn by Gabriel Reyes, under his "Reaper" persona.
The mask is a specialized breathing apparatus that resembles a white jack-o-lantern with narrowed red eye slits. Its breathing mechanisms aside, the mask is also worn by Reyes in part to protect his identity, since he wants the world to believe him to be dead.
The mask connects to Reyes's armor, and has a comms. system, which can receive audio feeds, and amplify Reyes's own voice (like his sinister laugh). It is apparently customizable, able to have functions such as a HUD, a gas filter, and an omnidirectional comms system connected to a GPS.

entries.name: Sojourn, Vivian Chase, Vivian
entries.content:
Sojourn (51 years old) was a member of Overwatch, joining at some point in the organization's Golden Age and staying with them into their twilight years. From soldier to Overwatch captain to veteran, Sojourn has devoted her life to helping those who would be made victims by the evils of the world.
Dedicated to the rule of law, Sojourn is detail-orientated. She is a brilliant tactician, a great leader, and a "measure twice, cut once" type of individual. She is known for her discipline, and is good at playing cards.
Sojourn has had a lot of cybernetic upgrades in her life, starting out of necessity in her childhood, before moving onto voluntary upgrades. Sojourn's legs and arms are cybernetic. Her left arm can transform into a disruptor cannon, and her legs are equipped with boosters that allow her to slide across the ground as if they were ice skates. Even without the boosters, her cybernetic legs and artificial heart allow her to run faster and harder than un-augmented humans. Due to the cybernetics, she feels less pain than a normal human, given that many of her body's pain receptors were removed to make room for the upgrades.
Sojourn has had at least two sets of cybernetic eyes. Her original lenses granted her infra-red vision. The second set was able to link with CSOR's intelligence network, and give her a detailed real-time view of battles, such as the location of friendly and enemy troops. The infra-red vision's range also increased. At some point, she received cybernetic brain upgrades. Her cybernetic upgrades have improved her speed, precision, and tactical prowess. Her original cybernetics made her slightly stronger than most humans, but still weaker than even humanoid omnics. After receiving her upgrades from Mina Liao, Sojourn's strength was increased to the point that she could fight off omnics with her bare (metallic) hands. Sojourn is at peace with her enhancements; for her, her cybernetics are a means to an end, only the objective matters. By the Second Omnic Crisis, Sojourn's cybernetics were no longer on the cutting edge.

entries.name: Soldier: 76, Soldier 76, Jack Morrison, John Francis "Jack" Morrison, Jack, Morrison
entries.content:
Currently the target of an international manhunt, the vigilante known as Soldier: 76 (58 years old) wages a personal war to expose the truth behind Overwatch's collapse.
Due to his genetic enhancement, Jack Morrison possesses physical capabilities exceeding those of a conventional soldier's, as well as other augmentations that make him a peerless combatant. He can heal wounds and acclimatize much faster than a normal human, his regenerative abilities only surpassed by Gabriel Reyes. In addition, he utilizes a cutting-edge arsenal, much of it stolen in raids on Overwatch installations. He is said to have perfect aim.
He is of Catholic faith. He has a smile that he uses to get himself out of trouble, though is usually taciturn. He is well-read, showing interest in historical generals, and is a chess player. He is also good at cards, and is a fan of American football.
Morrison has always been a light sleeper. The mask he wears distorts his voice. Jaded by his experiences, he considers pacifism to be foolish.
Armed with cutting-edge weaponry, including an experimental pulse rifle that’s capable of firing spirals of high-powered Helix Rockets, Soldier: 76 has the speed and support know-how of a highly trained warrior.
entries.comment: Soldier: 76, Soldier 76, Jack Morrison, John Francis "Jack" Morrison, Jack, Morrison

entries.name: Second Omnic Crisis, Second Omnic War
entries.content:
The Second Omnic Crisis was a human-omnic conflict that was being waged in Russia.
During the first Omnic Crisis, the Russian Defense Forces were able to defeat the omnics and shut down their omnium in Siberia. Thirty years later, the omnium reactivated and the region was thrust into conflict once again. The country ordered Volskaya Industries to increase Svyatogor production to deal with the increased hostilities. Likewise, the company developed a new type of mech in order to combat the omnics. Propaganda was employed to remind the populace of the continued omnic threat, and a coordinated offensive was made against the omnics. By the time of Winston's recall of Overwatch, the conflict had claimed over 15,000 lives, with the international community reluctant to intervene. Fighting had also occurred in Asia, South America, Europe, Australia, and the United States.
entries.comment: Second Omnic Crisis, Second Omnic War

entries.name: Vishkar Corporation, Vishkar
entries.content:
The Vishkar Corporation is a multinational corporate entity, classified as a megacorporation, based in southern India.
Vishkar maintains the Architech Academy where it trains individuals in the manipulation of light-bending. It is one of the most powerful corporations in the world, and is widely known for its use and application of hard-light.
Vishkar, at least in theory, is known for its public service works—houses, clean water, clinics, etc. While there may be some truth to that, Vishkar's activities also include more 'corporate' activities—luxury retreats, exclusive clubs, and "condominiums with prices as high as the skyscrapers that contain them." More than once, it has resorted to dubious tactics to achieve its goals.

entries.name: Architech Academy
entries.content:
The prestigeous Architech Academy is an institute maintained by the Vishkar Corporation. Here, students are trained in hard-light manipulation, becoming architechs. Most students take a procedural, mechanical approach in this regard, and the Academy instructors state that uniformity is strength, and that there is a formula for success that every student must follow.
The Academy grounds include gardens, and students share dorms. Non-Indian citizens can study at the Academy.

entries.name: Sombra, Olivia Colomar, Olivia
entries.content:
One of the world's most notorious hackers, Sombra (32 years old) uses information to manipulate those in power.
According to Doomfist, Sombra is one of the world's most dangerous operatives. Her skills include computer hacking and cryptography; these are activities she greatly enjoys, to the point where the desire to get past locks and solving mysteries is ingrained in her personality. Money is not one of her driving goals.
She is a known associate of Reaper, specializing in espionage and intelligence assessment. She is equipped with devices that allow hacking of technology just through touch. This includes cybernetic grafts implanted along her spine and her brain which basically makes her a living computer. She is a loner emotionally, finding it difficult to make friends (outside coercion). Her personal calling card is a sugar skull.
Stealth and debilitating attacks make Sombra a powerful infiltrator. She is the archetypal technomancer. Her hacking can disrupt her enemies, ensuring they're easier to take out, while her EMP provides the upper hand against multiple foes at once. Sombra’s ability to Translocate and camouflage herself makes her a hard target to pin down.

entries.name: Symmetra, Satya Vaswani, Satya, सत्य वासवानी, सत्य
entries.content:
Symmetra (30 years old) literally bends reality, and she is the Vishkar Corporation's premier hard-light architech. By manipulating hard-light constructs, she crafts the world as she wishes it to be, in hopes of engineering a perfect society. She believes her actions serve the greater good in society, though there are times when she wonders whether the control and order she desires are truly best for humanity. When light-bending, she uses Kathak dance movements.
She is on the autism spectrum; she has demonstrated traits associated with the condition such as having trouble with social interactions, suffering from sensory overload and preferring environments that are structured and harmonious. She finds it hard to make eye contact, engage in public speaking, and also finds it hard to sit still and has set routines, which ensure there is always order and calm in some part of her life. Lights give her trouble, both in their glare, and in a high-pitched whine that only she can hear.
She understands metaphors; however, she has trouble recognizing emotions. She regularly creates hard-light snowflakes, as their repetitive patterns bring peace to her mind. Trust doesn't come easily for her.
She does not hesitate to carry out missions of dubious morality for her company (such as digging up blackmail material to sabotage competitors), she dislikes killing and only resorts to lethal force if she has to. Despite the necessities of her job, fighting is not in her nature, though she remains competent all the same.
Utilizes her light-bending Photon Projector to dispatch adversaries, shield her associates, construct teleportation pads and deploy particle-blasting Sentry Turrets.
entries.comment: Symmetra, Satya Vaswani, Satya, सत्य वासवानी, सत्य

entries.name: Torbjörn, Torbjörn Lindholm
entries.content:
Torbjörn Lindholm (59 years old) is one of the greatest weaponsmiths and engineers in the world. He had a low opinion of omnics, believing them to be incapable of empathy, instead acting purely on logic, and disagreed with giving them the same rights as humans. His 'adoption' of Bastion, however, has caused him to question his antipathy to robots and omnics, and while still advocating for less reliance on AI, he has taken a more liberal view of the integration of omnics into society.
Jack Morrison considers Torbjörn's mind to be among the greatest humanity has ever produced. He has above average resilience.
His extensive arsenal includes a rivet gun and hammer, as well as a personal forge that he can use to build turrets.

entries.name: Tracer, Lena Oxton, Lena
entries.content:
The Overwatch agent Tracer (28 years old) is a time-jumping adventurer and an irrepressible force for good. She hails from London, and has traveled all over the world. With her irrepressible energy and boundless idealism, Tracer inspires her team and all who know her to fight for a better future.
She was a great admirer of Tekhartha Mondatta, and was inspired by Mei, an Overwatch scientist. She believes that sometimes, one simply has to do what is right, even if it's outside the law. She has always thought of herself as a soldier (at least since joining Overwatch), and is committed to protecting humans, omnics, and movements that could make the world better.
Tracer has abnormally fast reflexes and hand-eye coordination. She has trouble concentrating, only able to concentrate for hours at a time when she is upset. She is a fan of British pop/punk music, such as The Clash and The Beatles, and collects vinyl records. She is a crack shot in real-life, but terrible at videogames (yet apparently a good cook).
Toting twin pulse pistols, energy-based time bombs, and rapid-fire banter, she is able to "blink" through space and rewind her personal timeline as she battles to right wrongs the world over.

entries.name: Venture, Sloan Cameron, Sloan
entries.content:
An eccentric and daring adventurer, Venture (26 years old) is a charismatic and enthusiastic non-binary archaeologist with a passion for solving history's mysteries. When danger calls, they always answers. As a member of the Wayfinder Society, Venture travels the world, using their excavating tools to uncover artifacts and protect archaeological sites from looters, thieves, and more dangerous criminal organizations.
Venture's archeological interests are varied and at times, apparently contradictory. Omnic archeology is their favorite specialization, while their favorites of archeology include Classical, Medieval, Peruvian, and Egyptian. They also like Baroque architecture, and love ice-cream.

entries.name: Widowmaker, Amélie Lacroix (née Guillard), Amélie
entries.content:
Widowmaker (35 years old) is the perfect assassin: a patient, ruthlessly efficient killer who shows neither emotion nor remorse. Once, her only two loves were dancing and her husband Gérard Lacroix, but now, her only joy is found in the moment of the kill. An unstoppable killer, her crosshairs are perhaps the most dangerous place in the world.
She does not keep track of the number of people she's killed, and prefers to work alone. She is unaffected by low temperatures.
After several unsuccessful attempts to eliminate Gérard, Talon decided to change its focus to his wife. In the dead of night, Talon operatives kidnapped Amélie and subjected her to an intense program of neural reconditioning, breaking her will.
She returned to Talon and turned into a living weapon through intense training and genetic engineering. Talon’s geneticist, Moira O'Deorain, altered Amélie’s physiology to improve her aim, drastically slowing her heart, which turned her skin cold and blue permanently, and numbed her ability to experience human emotion.
She equips herself with whatever it takes to eliminate her targets, including mines that dispense poisonous gas, a visor that grants her squad infra-sight, and a powerful sniper rifle that can fire in fully-automatic mode.

entries.name: Ana, Ana Amari, أنا عماري, أنا
entries.content:
One of the founding members of Overwatch, Ana (62 years old) uses her skills and expertise to defend her home and the people she cares for. Hailing from a long line of decorated soldiers, Ana inspired confidence and loyalty in her colleagues and endowed her daughter, Pharah, with an intense sense of duty and honor. Like her daughter, she bore a tattoo of an Eye of Horus as a symbol of protection. Likewise, her callsign in the Egyptian military during the Omnic Crisis was "Horus." To this day, Ana is regarded as a hero by the Egyptian people.
Ana was regarded as one of the world's deadliest snipers, and has a high kill count. She is able to stay still for hours, waiting for the perfect shot. She originally used a Kinamura rifle, upon which she added a notch for every life she took. Each life weighed heavily on her conscience. She preferred to perform clean kills, disliking causing needless suffering. Her right eye, originally cybernetic, made her vision six times greater than normal, to the extent where she rarely even needed to use the scope. While procedures exist that could repair her cybernetic eye, she feels comfortable with her eyepatch, seeing it as a reminder of who she is now. She continues to experience phantom pain from the eye injury. In light of her experiences, Ana now prefers to avoid taking lives when possible, in contrast to her earlier approach of never leaving an enemy alive.
Her versatile arsenal allows her to affect heroes all over the battlefield. Her Biotic Rifle rounds and Biotic Grenades heal allies and damage or impair enemies; her Sleep Dart tranquilizes key targets, and Nano Boost gives one of her comrades a considerable increase in power.
entries.comment: Ana, Ana Amari, أنا عماري, أنا

entries.name: Baptiste, Jean-Baptiste Augustin
entries.content:
An elite combat medic and ex-Talon operative, Baptiste (38 years old) now uses his skills to help those whose lives have been impacted by war. He possesses an innate desire to help people. He wields an assortment of experimental devices and weaponry to keep allies alive and eliminate threats under fierce conditions. As an ex-mercenary, he made use of whatever he could find lying around. A battle-hardened combat medic, Baptiste is just as capable of saving lives as he is of taking out the enemy. He heals where he can, and fights when he must. He knows that he cannot undo his past, but making a difference is now what matters.
Baptiste loves to eat— it has been suggested that his favorite dish is pork griot and lalo. Not many people know that he has a sweet tooth, and he loves to kick back with a tall drink with a lot of ice. He is fluent in Haitian Creole, French, and English. His equipment is a collection of armor and weaponry acquired over the years. Some are from the black market, and some are modified from his Caribbean Coalition and Talon gear; Baptiste has always been resourceful.

entries.name: Brigitte, Brigitte Lindholm
entries.content:
Brigitte Lindholm (25 years old) is the youngest daughter of Torbjörn and Ingrid Lindholm, and is a traveling companion of Reinhardt Wilhelm. No longer sitting on the sidelines, she has taken up arms to defend those in need of protection. A Lindholm through and through, Brigitte's aptitude for engineering is matched by her sense of honor. She is very stubborn, a trait inherited from her father.
She spars with Reinhardt every day. Afterwards, she and Reinhardt go to a pub or tavern to relax. She likes doughnuts, and loves semlor. Brigitte has regular workouts, but also "cheat days" where she gorges on food. These "cheat days" occur at her discretion.
She specializes in protection. She can throw Repair Packs to heal teammates, as well as automatically heal nearby allies when she damages foes. Her Rocket Flail can strike multiple close-range targets when swung normally, or a single medium-range target via the Whip Shot. When entering the fray, her Barrier Shield provides personal defense and can also be used offensively with Shield Bash. Brigitte’s ultimate ability, Rally, gives her a small short-term speed boost and provides longer-lasting Overhealth to her nearby allies, as well as a personal boost of armor for herself.

entries.name: Illari, Illari Quispe Ruiz
entries.content:
(18 years old)
As the last of the Inti Warriors, Illari is a vessel for the power of the sun, due to solar threads woven throughout her body. With the sun's power, she is able to wreak havoc behind enemy lines. She is a ruthless vigilante plagued by a dark past of destroying her group after a solar outburst during the ceremony: one that she'll do anything to make up for.
Illari often hums when she's thinking; it is an automatic reflex, one she's unable to stop. She has a tendency to apologize as a side effect of her guilt.
She harnesses the power of the sun in her Solar Rifle, capable of dealing long range poke damage and creating a high-output healing beam. She can also deploy a healing pylon to automatically heal nearby allies. Her ultimate ability fires an explosive ball of solar energy that slows enemies in a massive area and causes them to burst upon taking more damage.

entries.name: Juno, Juno Teo Minh
entries.content:
Juno (19 years old) is the first human to have been born on Mars. This experience has shaped who she is. She is not well-versed in the ways of Terrans, which makes her anxious and uncertain at times. Her heroism comes from her ability to face her fears, and figure things out. She is exceptionally curious, and wants to learn all there is to know about Earth.
She’s afraid, but she’s still going to brave it and figure everything out. Plus, even though she’s terrified and overwhelmed, she’s also super curious. She wants to learn all there is to know about Earth, and with the help of Mei, she’s going to find a lot of wonderful things to experience for the first time.
Juno speaks formally as a side effect of growing up in an adult-only environment.

entries.name: Kiriko, Kiriko Kamori, 家守 霧子, 霧子
entries.content:
Kiriko (21 years old) is cheeky and full of life. She has tongue-in-cheek style humor, and is not afraid of teasing others, regardless of how intimidating they might seem. She exudes youthful energy and intelligence; a combination that makes her an extremely personable warrior. She loves to kid around with her teammates, and any disrespect or sass sent her way is simply redirected. Like the Fox Spirit that aids her, Kiriko is a trickster but has a strong moral compass, and believes in taking care of those around her.
For generations, the Yamagami family served and protected Kanezaka by following traditional paths. Kiriko, however, forged her own path by mixing the old and the new. While she respects tradition, Kiriko believes that traditions must change to reflect modern thinking. The influences of her grandmother and mother have shaped Kiriko into a hybrid of healer and warrior; a bridge of the traditional and the modern. She will do anything to protect her family and community, even if she has to bend a few rules.
Kiriko is cunning and agile. Through her training, Kiriko is proficient in the ways of both Miko and Kunoichi. She is a skilled martial artist, and has demonstrated seemingly supernatural abilities, such as teleportation and healing; in the case of the latter, she utilizes ofuda, but can heal minor injuries without them.
She is a kunoichi healer who is aided by her kitsune spirit. She can throw protection suzu to her allies or kunai against her enemies.
She is a family friend of the Shimada Family. She also trained in the early days with Genji and Hanzo.
entries.comment: Kiriko, Kiriko Kamori, 家守 霧子, 霧子

entries.name: Lifeweaver, Niran Pruksamanee, นิรันดร์ "บัว" พฤกษามณี, Bua, นิรันดร์
keys: นิรันดร์ "บัว" พฤกษามณี
entries.content:
Lifeweaver (31 years old) is a scientist from Thailand who harnesses his biolight technology on his mission to heal the world. Entwining the beauty of nature with the practicality of science, he is an intelligent and curious adventurer who plans to use his biolight technology to make the world a better place. Openly pansexual, sociable, witty, kind, cool, and confident, He has deep love and respect for nature, and is always looking to lift up those in need (sometimes literally). He strives to find beauty in the world around him.
He is a team player who loves collaboration, and has the best intentions for all he encounters. However, while he's doing the right thing in his mind, not everyone appreciates his actions. His charm and wit are sure to bring a smile (and maybe a blush) to the heroes who encounter him on the battlefield. He often appears distracted, daydreaming even, but this is simply his style. Whatever occupies his mind at any given moment, he gives it his full attention.
entries.comment: Lifeweaver, Niran Pruksamanee, นิรันดร์ "บัว" พฤกษามณี, Bua, นิรันดร์

entries.name: Lúcio, Lúcio Correia dos Santos
entries.content:
Lúcio (28 years old) is an international celebrity who inspires social change through his music and actions. He has a positive, up-beat attitude, and is always looking towards the future. He finds it difficult to calm down.
Lúcio wears hard-light skates that project hard-light "blades," allowing him to traverse any surface.
His cutting-edge Sonic Amplifier buffets enemies with projectiles and knocks foes back with blasts of sound. His musical beats can both heal his team or boost their movement speed.

entries.name: Mercy, Angela Ziegler, Angela, Ziegler, Dr. Angela Ziegler
entries.content:
A guardian angel to those who come under her care, Dr. Angela Ziegler (39 years old) is a peerless healer, a brilliant scientist, and a staunch advocate for peace. She is one of the most gifted doctors in the world when it comes to medical technology, and has applied such technology to her own body. She likes Swiss chocolate and enjoys tea, which she sometimes takes with a nip of brandy after a life-threatening ordeal. She isn't good at making coffee however—Genji was the only Overwatch member who could stand to drink it. She has a low opinion of Vishkar.
Her Valkyrie Suit helps keep her close to teammates like a guardian angel; healing, resurrecting or strengthening them with the beams emanating from her Caduceus Staff.
entries.comment: Mercy, Angela Ziegler, Angela, Ziegler, Dr. Angela Ziegler

entries.name: Moira, Moira O'Deorain, O'Deorain
entries.content:
Equal parts brilliant and controversial, scientist Moira O'Deorain (50 years old) is on the cutting edge of genetic engineering, searching for a way to rewrite the fundamental building blocks of life. Though O'Deorain will go to any lengths to make scientific breakthroughs, her work is still unknown to most of the world.
O'Deorain presents herself as being calm and logical, though in truth, she enjoys her science more when playing with hapless test subjects. She has not experimented on omnics... yet.
O'Deorain has a negative view of Overwatch, claiming that it was responsible for stifling scientific advancement for decades. She has no interest in global conquest, but is willing to work with those who might have such a goal. Her intellectual pursuits are driven by her interest in humanity. She is a geneticist first and foremost, and that's the scope of her ambition. With very flexible morals, O'Deorain prefers to focus on her research and has no patience for those who urge caution or restraint. She is uncaring of the goals of those she allies with, provided that they continue to fund her research.
Her right hand is heavily scarred; it has been speculated that it is a result of experimentation or a genetic anomaly.
Her biotic abilities enable her to heal or damage in any crisis. She can also Fade to escape groups or remain close to allies in need of support.

entries.name: Zenyatta, Tekhartha Zenyatta
entries.content:
(33 years old)
Zenyatta is an omnic monk who wanders the world in search of spiritual enlightenment, helping those he meets to overcome their personal struggles and find inner peace. It is said that those who cross his path are never the same again. He believes that by forming people into relationships, the world can be healed, and a better society created. However, he is not a pacifist, and when necessary, he will fight to protect the innocent, be they omnic or human.
The orbs he uses were hand-carved at the Shambali monastary and serve as a means to channel omnic energy. He does not know who exactly created them and their function is a mystery. While seemingly magical, in his words, "what seems like magic is sometimes science we don't yet understand." Similarly, he is able to levitate without repulsors, an ability he has attributed to the Iris.
He believes that as long as free will exists, there will always be evil in the world, yet to deny free will would also be evil. He has the ability to dream.
He found humans' manner of speech perplexing at first, having little grasp of metaphors. He still occasionally struggles with their figures of speech.
Like all Shambali, despite being unable to eat, he knows how to prepare food. He likes being near the coast, as it reminds him of where he was constructed.
He calls upon orbs of harmony and discord to heal his teammates and weaken his opponents, all while pursuing a transcendent state of immunity to damage.

entries.name: Kathak
entries.content: Kathak is one of the nine major forms of Indian classical dance. Kathak dancers tell various stories utilizing hand movements and extensive footwork, their body movements and flexibility as well as their facial expressions.

entries.name: Gothenburg
entries.content: Gothenburg is a city in Sweden, and the hometown of Torbjörn and Brigitte. It is also the site of Torbjörn's workshop, where he is assisted by Bastion in researching and designing weapon systems.

entries.name: Mondatta, Tekhartha Mondatta
entries.content: Tekhartha Mondatta (deceased) was an omnic and leader of the Shambali. As a member of the Shambali, Mondatta believed in peace between humans and omnics, stating that continued conflict served neither side.

entries.name: Shambali
entries.content: The Shambali are a clandestine order of omnics that were led by Tekhartha Mondatta. Despite not being able to eat, the Shambali know how to use food in order to spread peace and empathy to those they pass. They believe that omnics possess souls in the same manner as humans.

entries.name: Shambali Monastery
entries.content:
The monastery is located deep in the Himalayas. A village is located beneath the monastery, where there exists a number of shops that specialize for omnic travelers, such as repair shops and tailors. While the monastery is currently occupied by the Shambali, human visitors are welcome.
Countless omnics sought refuge within Shambali Monastery's walls and winding paths. It was the home of Zenyatta and Ramattra.

entries.name: Wayfinder Society, Wayfinders, Wayfinder
entries.content: The Wayfinder Society is a research group of archaeologists and historians from around the globe. Apprenticeships can be undertaken as early as the age of 16 before graduating into full membership. The Wayfinders have studied ancient ruins and derelict omniums. It has its own bioarcheology team. The Ironclad Guild provided them with tools.

entries.name: Ironclad Guild
entries.content:
The Ironclad Guild is a research and development group that is dedicated to improving the world through technology. They provided the Wayfinder Society with tools.
Before the Omnic Crisis, leading engineers across Europe founded the Ironclad Guild with a strictly altruistic mission: crafting inventions to improve the world, then making those inventions available to everyone without restrictive patents.
Though the Guild saved many lives during the Crisis, some of their technological advancements, like the massive skyscraper-building robot known as the Titan, were repurposed as weapons by Anubis, prompting a fair amount of soul-searching after the war.
The group protested the construction of an omnium in Stockholm before it was shut down.

entries.name: Titan
entries.content: The Titan is a type of bi-pedal omnic. Titans were first conceived by the Ironclad Guild prior to the Omnic Crisis, with Torbjörn Lindholm playing a large role in their conception. The idea was to create a walker that would aid in the construction of high-rises. During the Omnic Crisis, the Titan design was pilfered by the omnics and retrofitted into a weapon of war.

entries.name: Gérard Lacroix, Gérard
entries.content: Gérard Lacroix (deceased) was an Overwatch agent who spearheaded operations against Talon.

entries.name: Biotic Rifle
entries.content: The biotic rifle is a nanobiotic weapon owned and utilized by Ana. Designed by Torbjörn. Angela disapproves of Ana's use of her biotic rifle. The rifle's scope has a thermal setting. It can fire a variety of rounds, like stun, damaging, and healing rounds.

entries.name: Kinamura
entries.content: The Kinamura is a type of sniper rifle. It is equipped with a scope, and can fire .338 rounds. It's accurate up to 2000 meters, with a bullet speed of 980 meters per second. During her time with Overwatch, Ana Amari used a Kinamura. She added a notch to the rifle for every life she took.

entries.name: Nanobiotics, Nanobiotic, Biotics, Biotic
entries.content: Nanobiotics are a field of medical technology pioneered by Angela Ziegler. Despite the technology's namesake, it does not involve nanorobotics or similar technology. She developed the technology for the sake of healing and saving civilian lives. However, Overwatch militarised the technology and made harmful nanobiotic weapons, like the Biotic Rifle and Biotic Grenades. Now it is used to both heal and harm.

entries.name: Caduceus Staff
entries.content: The Caduceus staff is a piece of medical technology operated by Angela Ziegler. It operates via nanobiotic technology, generating a healing stream of biotic energy into its intended recipient. Alternatively, the beam can be used to strengthen the target.

entries.name: Caribbean Coalition
entries.content: A military force composed of a number of Caribbean nations. It was formed in response to the Omnic Crisis. It has a special ops branch. Over time, a number of Coalition members have transferred to other organizations. In the case of a number of the Coalition's special ops soldiers, Talon was a common choice at the end of their tour of duty. Not only could the organization offer them lucrative deals, but it could take advantage of their specialized skillsets.

entries.name: Inti Warriors, Inti Warrior, Solar Protectors, Solar Warriors, The Children of the Sun
entries.content: The Inti Warriors (a.k.a. the Solar Protectors, Solar Warriors, or The Children of the Sun) were a group of soldiers utilized by the Paqarina Research Group. The Inti Warriors were an augmented group of noble protectors and masters of solar energy. In addition to being equipped with solar rifles and healing pylons, the Warriors utilized a number of fighting styles. In order to store and control the sun's power, each Inti Warrior was imbued with solar threading. Training to join the warriors began (or at least could begin) from a young age. Traditionally, each Inti Warrior had an augmentation ceremony, during which all the warriors would gather in the inductee's honor. Only a select number of individuals were capable of becoming Inti Warriors, given how few were able to endure solar threading.
entries.comment: Inti Warriors, Inti Warrior, Solar Protectors, Solar Warriors, The Children of the Sun

entries.name: Solar Rifle
entries.content:
The Solar rifle is a rifle that utilizes solar energy, utilized by the Inti Warriors.
The rifle has two primary functions. The first is the ability to fire solar energy as a projectile. The second is to use that same energy as a healing beam. The rifle can also be transformed into a blade.

entries.name: Solar Threading
entries.content:
Solar Threading is used by Inti Warriors to give them the ability to store and control the sun's power. Solar threading are imbued into Inti warriors and are used to concentrate solar energy for damage or healing purposes. Typically, solar rifles are used to best utilize solar energy and solar threading.
Inti Warriors are imbued with solar threading through an augmentation ceremony, which allow them to harness solar energy. When channelling solar energy, solar threading will glow a bright yellow to represent the sun's power. When not channelling solar energy, solar threading on the skin will look like tattoos, while solar threading in hair will appear as yellow streaks.

entries.name: Biolight
entries.content:
Biolight is a living and growing variation of hard-light fused with plantlife developed by Niran. While unstable, it creates organic material that can heal terrible wounds in the blink of an eye. Niran is known for using biolight flowers to heal allies.
Biolight has great potential in the fields of medicine and agriculture, but given its self-propagating nature, it could be deadly in the wrong hands.

entries.name: Aurora
entries.content: Aurora was first sentient omnic, who sacrificed herself in order to grant sentience to all others. She was capable of independent decision making, and her personality developed as such. She was possessed of innate curiosity, curious about the world and its people, and her own being. Even before she knew what she was, she possessed a moral code.

entries.name: The Iris
entries.content:
The Iris is a unique energy anomaly located in the Himalayas, deep beneath the Shambali Monastery. It is the outcome of Aurora's sacrifice and became a concept within the Shambali faith. When Aurora sacrificed herself, the Shambali believe that she transcended existence itself. The Shambali strive to reach this level of being which they refer to as "the Iris." The Shambali believe that all beings, both organic and mechanical, can achieve this higher state of being through the Iris, and that within it, all are one.
The Iris cannot be explained by human science.
